text:
maria: Quick status — ACME reporting 95th percentile embeddings latency >2s since yesterday's deploy. CS marked as SLA risk, asking for engineering commitment. Who can own rollback or hotfix?

devon: I'm oncall today, can take initial triage. Early signs point at PR#4321 (batching/backpressure tweak) causing higher tail.

sachin: I own batching. That change reworked the cache flush heuristics; I can prepare a revert branch. How long do we need for QA?

maria: CS needs a timeline to share with the customer within 2 hours. Is a hotfix + canary realistic in that window?

devon: Minimal revert + feature-flag toggle plan: I can get a staging preview in ~45m. If staging looks good we can canary in ~90m. Canary healthchecks for 30m, then prod push. That's tight but doable. Tagging @kyle-ops for canary ops.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled by request. scheduled_at: 1801238123. Healthcheck_window: 30m. Auto-rollback on >3% error increase.

elaine: I'll prep the CS message templates and coordinate customer comms. If canary passes, we go prod with 30m monitoring and rollback plan.

sachin: Opening PR with revert + reintroduce via config flag later. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/serving/pulls/4388

devon: Also adding a temporary rate-limit to embeddings to reduce incoming pressure while we deploy. Snippet: 
````
embeddings:
  requests_per_minute: 1200
````
kyle-ops, can you apply to prod-tier-alpha asap?

kyle-ops: Applying rate-limit now to prod-tier-alpha; expect propagation ~10m. Will monitor.

maria: CS update drafted: 'We're deploying a targeted fix; expect material improvement ~2 hours. We'll send a status update in 30 minutes.' :hourglass_flowing_sand:

elaine: Noted. I'll post interim update and escalate if canary shows any regressions.

devon: After revert lands I'll run a quick smoke harness against the ACME workload. If all green, we proceed to prod.

maria: Thanks everyone. Action items: sachin -> open PR (done), devon -> staging/canary timeline, kyle-ops -> rate-limit + canary ops, elaine -> customer comms. We'll reconvene in #eng-platform with short updates. :thumbsup:
